title: Write the employee handbook
summary: Draft and publish comprehensive employee handbook covering policies, PTO, conduct, remote work, and equity.

parts.title: Draft handbook sections
parts.guidance: Outline the policies employees need using existing employment terms and actual company practices. Cover working arrangements, leave, conduct, reporting concerns, security and everyday operating expectations at the right level of detail. Flag undecided policies and provisions needing local review. Use placeholders for proposed benefits or procedures until the responsible team settles them.

parts.title: Customize policies for company
parts.guidance: Work through each draft policy with the person who will administer it. Resolve differences between written leave, remote-work, expense or conduct rules and actual practice. Make contacts and escalation paths specific, and identify where country or worker-group versions are needed. Track substantive changes so the legal reviewer can see the policies the company intends to operate.

parts.title: Legal review
parts.guidance: Give counsel the draft, worker locations, relevant employment documents and substantive policy changes. Ask for the required local provisions, consultation or notice steps and conflicts with existing terms. Resolve legal questions with counsel and business choices with the people lead before release. Identify any excluded country or unresolved policy so a reviewed handbook version is not assumed to cover every employee automatically.

parts.title: Publish to Notion
parts.guidance: Publish the reviewed handbook in the employee knowledge space with a clear owner, effective version and question route. Check that employees can reach the live document and that drafts or legal advice remain restricted. Preserve earlier versions so the company can identify the policy that applied at a particular time. Link country or worker-group addenda where employees would expect to find them.

parts.title: Send announcement to team
parts.guidance: Tell employees where the handbook lives, which changes affect them and when those changes apply. Explain any acknowledgement process and provide a contact for questions. Check the published link before distribution and arrange accessible or translated material where needed. Route substantive questions to the relevant policy owner and follow up through the company’s actual acknowledgement process.

geoNotes.summary: The statutory cousin is standing orders under the Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act — certified workplace rules once headcount crosses the state threshold; below it, a well-drafted HR policy plus state shops-and-establishments rules carry the load.

A written statement of particulars is a DAY-ONE legal right for every employee — the handbook builds on it, and disciplinary/grievance procedures should track the Acas code that tribunals measure employers against.

The Nachweisgesetz requires the essential terms of employment in writing (tightened in 2022, with fines); from five employees a works council (Betriebsrat) can be elected, and many 'handbook' topics become co-determination matters.

At 50+ employees a règlement intérieur is mandatory — a formal document covering discipline, health/safety and harassment, filed with the labour inspectorate and the prud'hommes — and it must be in French.

metadata.supportReason: AI can draft sections from templates. Legal review and company-specific policies need human input.
